subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public native `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` contract for `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents`, with current channel behavior as the default?
rationale: This adds a new core tool/config surface in a session-state and delivery path, so automation cannot decide the permanent product/API contract even though the source gap and linked implementation path are clear.

options.title: Accept the native contract
options.body: Review and land the linked implementation after conflict resolution, upgrade-safety review, and real behavior proof for parent-targeted completion routing.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Keep the issue open but require the PR to reduce scope, such as per-spawn-only routing or no config default, before merge.

options.title: Decline the core option
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR only if maintainers decide existing callback/parent-handoff patterns are the supported orchestration path.

recommendation.title: Accept the native contract
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked implementation after conflict resolution, upgrade-safety review, and real behavior proof for parent-targeted completion routing.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current code-history signal on the affected subagent announce and sessions_spawn surfaces and already provided detailed acceptance criteria in the discussion.
